inOneSentence: One thin foundation, then two entries at once, then one journey across them.

threeThings.p: Sending and accepting each prove alone on factory data, so neither waits for the other.
The cross journey clicks the Invite form, which only the send entry builds.
The e-mail sandbox key; without it the send entry parks and the rest goes on.

needsYourEye.p: Chosen for width: one more merge, twice the parallel work.

foundationPlain: The table, both routes and the factories land first, alone, so no entry touches a shared file.
graphPlain: Width two, depth two; the send entry starts first because the journey waits for it.
reviewPlain: One round: the reviewer and three blind readers; two findings sustained and fixed, one dismissed.
